quests.instruction: A bowl of creamy tomato soup is smooth and soft. Which topping would add a crunchy contrast?
quests.hint: Imagine something you crumble on top.
quests.explanation: Crackers add crunch against a soft, creamy soup. Cream and butter would make it even smoother.
quests.funFact: Cooks mix textures in a dish because contrast makes food more interesting to eat.

quests.instruction: A plate holds pale rice, pale potatoes and pale bread. Which food would add a splash of bright color?
quests.hint: Look for a color that stands out.
quests.explanation: Red pepper strips bring bright color and fresh crunch to a pale plate. The other foods are as pale as the rest.
quests.funFact: Colorful foods often come from fruits and vegetables.

quests.instruction: A curry is so spicy that your mouth is burning. Which food helps cool it down?
quests.hint: Imagine something cool and creamy.
quests.explanation: Dairy foods like yogurt and milk calm the burn of spicy food. Hot sauce adds more spice and crackers do not help.
quests.funFact: Spicy cuisines often serve yogurt-based sides, such as raita in India.

quests.instruction: What tool is best for eating a bowl of soup?
quests.hint: Think about what happens to liquid on the other tools.
quests.explanation: A spoon holds liquid, so it works for soup. A fork and chopsticks let the liquid slip through.
quests.funFact: Spoons are among the oldest eating tools, first made from wood, shell and bone.

quests.instruction: Which pair of thin sticks is an everyday eating tool for noodles and rice in many Asian countries?
quests.hint: You hold them in one hand and pinch the food.
quests.explanation: Chopsticks are used in China, Japan, Korea and other places to pick up food. Skewers are used for cooking and forks have prongs.
quests.funFact: Chopsticks have been used in China for thousands of years.

quests.instruction: A friend says they do not like a food that you love. What is a kind way to respond?
options: Tell them they are being silly 😠
quests.hint: Ask yourself how you would like to be treated.
quests.explanation: People have different tastes, and that is perfectly fine. Being kind means respecting a friend's choice.
quests.funFact: Tastes can change over time, so a food you dislike now might become a favorite later.

quests.instruction: Guacamole is a dip made by mashing which creamy green fruit with lime, onion and salt?
quests.hint: It has one big seed in the middle.
quests.explanation: Avocados are soft and creamy, so they mash into a smooth dip. Kiwis and cucumbers do not become creamy.
quests.funFact: The word guacamole comes from an Aztec word meaning avocado sauce.

quests.instruction: Greek tzatziki is a cool dip made from yogurt, garlic and which crunchy, watery vegetable?
quests.hint: It is cool and refreshing.
quests.explanation: Cucumber adds a cool, fresh crunch to tzatziki. Carrots and corn are not used in it.
quests.funFact: Tzatziki is often served with grilled meat and pita bread in Greece.

quests.instruction: Which Spanish dish is rice cooked in a wide, shallow pan with vegetables and seafood or chicken?
quests.hint: It is named after the pan it is cooked in.
quests.explanation: Paella is a rice dish from Spain. A burrito is a wrapped tortilla and falafel is made of chickpeas.
quests.funFact: Paella is named after the wide, shallow pan it is cooked in.

quests.instruction: A family plans an outdoor barbecue on a hot summer day. Which menu fits best?
quests.hint: Imagine foods that suit the heat and the grill.
quests.explanation: Corn grills well and watermelon is refreshing. Oatmeal is a breakfast food and soup and stew are too warm for a hot day.
quests.funFact: Barbecues are popular in many countries, and each has its own favorite foods.

quests.instruction: Which snack is best for a long car ride because it is dry, small and does not drip?
quests.hint: Think about what could make a mess.
quests.explanation: Pretzels are dry and easy to eat. An ice pop melts and spaghetti is messy.
quests.funFact: Dry, bite-sized snacks are popular for travel because they keep well.

quests.instruction: At a school bake sale outdoors with no fridge, which treat is the safest to sell?
quests.hint: Ask yourself which treats need to stay cold.
quests.explanation: Cookies are dry and keep well without cooling. Cream cakes and yogurt spoil quickly when warm.
quests.funFact: Foods with lots of milk or cream spoil more quickly than dry baked goods.

quests.instruction: What breakfast dish is made of beaten eggs cooked in a pan and folded over a filling?
quests.hint: It is folded like a half-moon.
quests.explanation: An omelet is made from beaten eggs. Pancakes and waffles are made from batter.
quests.funFact: Omelets can be filled with cheese, vegetables, mushrooms or herbs.

quests.instruction: Which crunchy, salty snack is made from thin slices of potato?
quests.hint: Its main ingredient grows underground.
quests.explanation: Chips are thin slices of potato cooked until crisp. Popcorn is made from corn and pretzels from dough.
quests.funFact: Potato chips are called crisps in the United Kingdom.

quests.instruction: Which dish is long noodles served with round balls of meat in tomato sauce?
quests.hint: Round balls sit on top of the noodles.
quests.explanation: Spaghetti and meatballs combines noodles, meatballs and sauce. Dumplings and tacos look quite different.
quests.funFact: Meatballs are made in many cultures, from Swedish kottbullar to Middle Eastern kofta.

quests.instruction: Which sense lets you notice the aroma of bread baking in another room?
quests.hint: You do not need to see or touch the bread.
quests.explanation: Smell travels through the air, so you can notice bread baking even from far away.
quests.funFact: Smell is a big part of flavor, which is why food tastes dull when your nose is blocked.

quests.instruction: Which part of the body has taste buds that sense sweet, sour, salty and bitter?
quests.hint: Taste buds are the tiny bumps there.
quests.explanation: Taste buds are on the tongue. Ears hear and eyes see.
quests.funFact: A tongue has thousands of tiny taste buds.

quests.instruction: Which words describe a fresh baguette?
quests.hint: Picture the golden crust and the fluffy middle.
quests.explanation: A fresh baguette has a crisp crust and a soft, airy center.
quests.funFact: A good baguette crackles softly when you squeeze it.

quests.instruction: Which soft, puffy bread from India is often eaten with curry?
quests.hint: It is baked in a very hot clay oven.
quests.explanation: Naan is a soft flatbread from India. A baguette is French and a bagel is a chewy ring.
quests.funFact: Naan is traditionally baked on the walls of a hot clay oven called a tandoor.

quests.instruction: Which Italian dish is made of layers of pasta sheets, sauce and cheese, baked in a dish?
quests.hint: You cut it into squares to serve.
quests.explanation: Lasagna is built in layers and baked. Ramen is a noodle soup and sushi is made with rice.
quests.funFact: Lasagna layers can include tomato sauce, cheese, vegetables or meat.

quests.instruction: Which popular party dish from West Africa is rice cooked in a tomato-based sauce?
quests.hint: It turns orange-red as it cooks.
quests.explanation: Jollof rice is made by cooking rice in a rich tomato sauce. Pierogi are filled dumplings and sushi is seasoned rice with fish.
quests.funFact: Jollof rice is enjoyed in many West African countries, and each place has its own way of making it.

quests.instruction: At the end of the week there are some leftover cooked vegetables. What is a smart way to use them?
quests.hint: Think about a warm meal in a pot.
quests.explanation: Leftover vegetables can go into soup or a stir-fry. Food left out overnight can spoil, and cooked vegetables will not grow.
quests.funFact: Using leftovers well helps cut down on food waste.

quests.instruction: Bananas with lots of brown spots are very soft and sweet. Which recipe uses them well?
quests.hint: Consider a baked loaf.
quests.explanation: Very ripe bananas are soft and sweet, so they are perfect for banana bread. Pickles and salad do not use them.
quests.funFact: Very ripe bananas are sweeter, which is why bakers favor them.

quests.instruction: A loaf of bread has gone a little stale and hard. What could you make from it?
quests.hint: Toast the pieces until they are crunchy.
quests.explanation: Stale bread can be cubed and toasted into croutons. Ice pops and juice are not made from bread.
quests.funFact: Stale bread can also be turned into breadcrumbs or bread pudding.

quests.instruction: Which one still has all the pulp and fiber of the fruit?
quests.hint: Ask yourself what is left behind when fruit is strained.
quests.explanation: A whole orange keeps its fiber. Straining juice removes some pulp, and soda is mostly flavored water.
quests.funFact: Fiber is the part of plants that our bodies cannot digest, and it helps digestion.

quests.instruction: Which of these is a whole fruit, with nothing added?
quests.hint: It has not been cooked or mixed with anything.
quests.explanation: A fresh peach is just the fruit itself. Pie and jam have sugar and other ingredients added.
quests.funFact: Whole foods are foods that stay close to the way they grow.

quests.instruction: A pasta salad has pasta, tomato, cucumber and olives. Which ingredient grows on a tree?
quests.hint: Think about the oil it can make.
quests.explanation: Olives grow on olive trees. Tomatoes and cucumbers grow on vines.
quests.funFact: A salad like this mixes foods from many different plants.

quests.instruction: A smoothie is made from banana, yogurt and strawberries. Which food groups does it include?
quests.hint: Ask yourself where each ingredient comes from.
quests.explanation: Banana and strawberries are fruits and yogurt is a dairy food.
quests.funFact: Smoothies are a handy way to mix several foods in one glass.

quests.instruction: A family has rice, beans, eggs, carrots, oranges and milk. Which plate has the most variety?
quests.correctAnswer: Rice, beans, carrots and an orange 🍚
options: Only milk, poured in a big glass 🥛
Only rice, piled high in a big bowl 🍚
Rice, beans, carrots and an orange 🍚
quests.hint: Count how many different kinds of food are on each plate.
quests.explanation: The first plate has a grain, a legume, a vegetable and a fruit. The others have only one kind of food.
quests.funFact: Eating many different kinds of food is advice that people share around the world.

quests.instruction: Why do people eat many different kinds of food, not just one?
quests.correctAnswer: Different foods give the body different things 🥗
options: Different foods give the body different things 🥗
Foods cannot be mixed on one plate ❌
All foods give the body exactly the same things 🍞
quests.hint: Ask yourself how many jobs your body has.
quests.explanation: Each kind of food gives the body something a little different, so a variety works best.
quests.funFact: Fruits, vegetables, grains, dairy and protein foods each play a different role in the body.
